text:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary r17 -> r16 — p95 latency +42% in us-west-2, error rate spike ~2%. Auto-rollback threshold breached for latency. Runbook: https://console.redwood/runbooks/rollback

danielle: pinging @sara (oncall) and @matt (platform) — are you seeing this on traces?

sara: yep seeing increased 5xx from tokenizer-prod-canary. stack traces point at tokenization timeouts, retry loop amplification. investigating.

matt: dashboards: https://dash.redwood/prod/canary?r=17 — looks correlated with token-kernel change in r17. p50 fine, but p95 and tail CPU on GPU nodes spiked.

emily: any customer-facing failures? support?

sara: small customer errors surfaced to a couple webhooks, nothing widespread yet. error budget at 0.9% (threshold 1%).

oliver: if no DB/schema changes, we can pin back quickly. confirm no migrations in r17?

matt: no migrations. chart and weights only. safe to rollback.

danielle: decision: manual rollback to r16. don't let deploy-bot auto-revert without signoff; we'll execute in 10m and notify support + SRE. @deploy-bot set mode=hold for auto-rollbacks on this release. :white_check_mark:

matt: I'll run the rollback command and pin images. command: ```
/deploy rollback --release r17 --target r16 --reason "p95 regression tokenization" --notify channels=prod-alerts,eng-oncall
```

deploy-bot: Received rollback request. Starting rollback job 1769012400. Steps: scale down r17 canary, deploy r16 replica set, run healthchecks, warm KV cache, verify traces. ETA ~6m.

sara: rolling health checks: all canaries returning 200s now. latency trending back to baseline.

matt: pinning chart: `image: registry.redwood/infra:release-r16` and `values.yaml` set `canary.enabled=false` during rollback window. Pushing commit and annotating release notes.

emily: preparing customer note: "We detected a performance regression during a limited canary and reverted to the previous version; no data loss; follow-up postmortem coming."

danielle: notifying support/sales: "Rollback executed, monitoring, will open postmortem and action items." @oliver please own postmortem, @sara will provide traces.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 1769012540. All checks passed. Trace sample link: https://traces.redwood/trace/abc123. Created incident ticket INC-1234 for follow-up.

oliver: thanks — creating postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood/pmems/INC-1234. Will include root cause hypothesis and rollback timeline.

danielle: closing thread for now. we'll discuss remediation (kernel fallback, better canary traffic split) in postmortem. :memo:
